title: Ruleset: new_game
description: rules/<id>/new_game.yaml: how a new game starts (apps/session: NewGameRules, apps/session/README.md): the partner's species and stats and the tamer's level.

partner.description: The Digimon id (data/digimon) the partner starts as; it needs a raise row.

stats.description: The partner's maximum stats when the packs have no data/new_game_stats (which the session uses instead); current HP and MP start full.

tamer_level.description: The tamer's level at the start, within the tamer section's limits.
